title: Show HN: I built a sub-500ms latency voice agent from scratch

excerpt: I built a voice agent from scratch that averages ~400ms end-to-end latency (phone stop → first syllable). excerpt: Gemini Embedding 2 can project raw video directly into a 768-dimensional vector space alongside text. No transcription, no frame captioning, no intermediate text. A query like "green car cutting me off" is directly comparable to a 30-second video clip at the vector level.
